47:1.text: (in the Oneness of Allâh, and in the Message of Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)
, He will render their deeds vain.

47:2.text: But those who believe and do righteous good deeds, and believe in that which is sent down to Muhammad
- for it is the truth from their Lord - He will expiate from them their sins, and will make good their state.

47:3.text: That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood, while those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. Thus does Allâh set forth for mankind their parables.

47:4.text: necks till when you have killed and wounded many of them, then bind a bond firmly
(on them, i.e. take them as captives)
, until the war lays down its burden. Thus
[you are ordered by Allâh to continue in carrying out Jihâd against the disbelievers till they embrace Islâm and are saved from the punishment in the Hell-fire or at least come under your protection]
, but if it had been Allâh’s Will, He Himself could certainly have punished them
in order to test some of you with others. But those who are killed in the Way of Allâh, He will never let their deeds be lost.

47:5.text: He will guide them and set right their state.

47:6.text: And admit them to Paradise which He has made known to them
(i.e. they will know their places in Paradise better than they used to know their homes in the world)

47:7.text: O you who believe! If you help
Allâh, He will help you, and make your foothold firm.

47:8.text: (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism)

47:9.text: That is because they hate that which Allâh has sent down
; so He has made their deeds fruitless.

47:10.text: Have they not travelled through the earth, and seen what was the end of those before them? Allâh destroyed them completely, and a similar

47:11.text: That is because Allâh is the Maulâ
of those who believe, and the disbelievers have no Maulâ
